quotes.text: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that. I have decided to stick with love. Hate is too great a burden to bear.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.text: Human beings are strong because we can change ourselves. It is not about the origin of your power, or the limits of your birth. It is about your willingness to move forward, no matter how hard it gets.
quotes.author: Saitama (One Punch Man)

quotes.text: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion. To live is to choose, and to choose is to define who you are.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.text: If you do not like your destiny, do not accept it. Instead, have the courage to change it the way you want it to be. The only true failure in life is not trying at all.
quotes.author: Naruto Uzumaki (Naruto)

quotes.text: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment. Do not follow where the path may lead. Go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: A person who cannot sacrifice anything, can never change anything. To defeat a monster, you must be willing to throw aside your humanity, your pride, and everything else that holds you back.
quotes.author: Armin Arlert (Attack on Titan)

quotes.text: The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy. True strength is found in the midst of adversity.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.text: Whatever you lose, you will find it again. But what you throw away, you will never get back. Remember that human life is fragile, and the decisions you make today will echo into your tomorrow.
quotes.author: Kenshin Himura (Rurouni Kenshin)

quotes.text: Two things awe me most, the starry sky above me and the moral law within me. The existence of these things proves that there is a grand design, even when our immediate world feels entirely chaotic.
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.text: The ticket to the future is always open. It does not matter if you are weak or if you have failed before. Every single second is a chance to rewrite the script of your life.
quotes.author: Vash the Stampede (Trigun)
